title: [Quality Management] Enable Bin code selection for transfer disposition in workflow response
summary: Bin code selection is now available for transfer disposition in workflow responses for quality inspections, matching the behavior of the manual disposition form.
key_points: Adds bin code selection capability to transfer disposition in workflow response options
Aligns workflow behavior with manual quality inspection disposition form
Affects Quality Management workflow response handling
Minimal code changes with net reduction in lines
Resolves synchronization issue between workflow and manual processes
quote: Synchronize behavior with manual disposition form quality inspection.
